scenarios.drift: world rule changed (fs: move accepts directories; view: grp:ext allowed on a filtered panel), E3 = 600 new exploration steps per body in the changed world; drift starts from each condition's stable-scenario state

conditions: FIXED (all records, human concepts + learner v4)
measures: prediction on unseen situations (stable: original world; drift: changed world, changed tool vs other tools)
new-task completion (stable: fs 60 / view 20 test tasks; drift: 20 drift tasks per body needing the changed capability)

decisions: revise / hold / re-verify counts, verification experiments, wrong revisions
